title: Registry Maximums, Calibration Intervals and Recall Reminders by CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan Tier
content:
Each tier of the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan sets how many instruments may be registered without an additional asset fee, the annual fee for each registered instrument above that maximum, the default calibration interval, how the next due date is set, and how far ahead of the due date the recall reminder is sent.

| Tier | Instruments registered without an additional asset fee | Annual fee per registered instrument above the maximum (USD) | Default calibration interval (months) | Next due date basis | Recall reminder (days before due date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CalCare Pay-Per-Service | 25 | 6.00 | 12 | last calibration date plus the interval | 30 |
| CalCare Basic Plan | 50 | 6.00 | 12 | last calibration date plus the interval | 30 |
| CalCare Standard Plan | 150 | 5.00 | 12 | last calibration date plus the interval | 30 |
| CalCare Accredited Plan | 300 | 4.00 | 12 | last calibration date plus the interval | 45 |
| CalCare Onsite Plan | 750 | 3.00 | 12 | last calibration date plus the interval | 45 |
| CalCare Enterprise Plan | 2500 | 2.00 | 12 | last calibration date plus the interval | 60 |

Settings explained:

- Registry maximum: instruments registered without an additional asset fee.
- Additional asset fee: annual fee per registered instrument above the registry maximum, USD.
- Default interval: calibration interval assigned when the customer does not specify one.
- Due date basis: how the next due date is set; on every tier the next due date is the last calibration date plus the instrument's calibration interval.
- Recall reminder: days before an instrument's due date that the recall reminder is sent.

The default interval of 12 months and the due date basis are the same on all six tiers; the recall reminder is sent 30 days ahead on the first three tiers, 45 days ahead on CalCare Accredited Plan and CalCare Onsite Plan and 60 days ahead on CalCare Enterprise Plan.

Hypothetical reading: a CalCare Basic Plan customer may register up to 50 instruments without an additional asset fee; each registered instrument above 50 carries 6.00 for the plan year.
